name: M&M's Peanut Chocolate Candies (Whole Nut WARNING)
whyItWorks: Each candy encases a whole roasted peanut. In patients with intestinal strictures or postoperative anastomotic narrowing, swallowed whole or partially chewed peanuts represent a leading cause of food-induced small bowel obstruction.
prepOrOrderInstructions: AVOID completely with stricturing Crohn's disease. Always select Plain M&M's.
